description: checks top-level fields against caller-declared JSON type names using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded json type map check result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for JSON Type Map Check as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

object.description: Object supplied to JSON Type Map Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

types.description: Types supplied to JSON Type Map Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_json_type_map_check
